locations.topic: Restricted gradient form, stationarity/continuity conditions, and a degenerate case for the stable-rank analysis.
Projection refresh trades optimizer-state fidelity and overhead against restricted-subspace progress; the theorem alone is not an overall-performance guarantee.
The 7B quality comparison uses a single trial without hyperparameter tuning on 64 A100 GPUs.
Single-device memory feasibility uses a small token batch; memory savings and throughput depend on per-layer updates and optimizer choice.
Rank, refresh frequency, and training length create a memory/computation/convergence trade-off.
Other model families, lower-memory projectors, and elastic consumer-hardware training remain open scope.
